title: Concrete coordinate cochain models preserve K-flatness
statement: For an affine coordinate a [def-pc-affine-coordinate-comparison-data], let CT_a be termwise tilde followed by termwise pushforward along a.σ.hom. Its localization is naturally isomorphic to the supplied a.H by a.hH and a.hd. Pushforward along a scheme isomorphism is an explicitly constructed equivalence with inverse pushforward along the inverse map. If M satisfies the acyclic-tensor K-flat criterion, CT_a(M) is K-flat as a cochain complex of module sheaves. The factored termwise chart agrees naturally with termwise application of the composite module functor.

source.place: Tag 06Y1 preservation under scalar extension, Tag 08DW affine tilde construction; coordinate transport along an isomorphism.

proof.text: Construct the chart functor and the pushforward equivalence using pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr, pushforwardId, and the supplied scheme isomorphism. Compose hH with hd for the localized model isomorphism.

Tilde preserves the supplied K-flat criterion; identify chart pushforward with tensor pullback along the inverse scheme isomorphism by uniqueness of left adjoints. Pullback preserves K-flatness, and invariance under the resulting termwise isomorphism proves the claim.
